typeProperties.command: .create table PolicyVersionMetrics (CorrelationId: string, InsertedAt: datetime, PolicyDomain: string, PolicyName: string, Version: string, PolicyMode: string, BuildId: string, PolicyRan: bool, PolicyPassed: bool, Data: string, MetaData: dynamic)
.create table RuleExecutionMetrics (CorrelationId: string, InsertedAt: datetime, BuildId: string, PolicyDomain: string, PolicyName: string, PolicyCompliantStatus: string)

.alter table PolicyVersionMetrics policy update @'[{"IsEnabled":true,"Source":"RawMetrics","Query":"RawMetrics | extend DomainResults = RawGatingResult.DomainResults | mv-expand DomainResult = DomainResults | where isnotnull(DomainResult) | extend PolicyResults = DomainResult.PolicyResults | mv-expand PolicyResult = PolicyResults | where isnotnull(PolicyResult) | extend PolicyVersionResults = PolicyResult.PolicyVersionResults | mv-expand PolicyVersionResult = PolicyVersionResults | where isnotnull(PolicyVersionResult) | mv-expand RuleResult = PolicyVersionResult.RuleResults | where isnotnull(RuleResult) | project CorrelationId, InsertedAt = now(), PolicyDomain = tostring(DomainResult.PolicyDomain), PolicyName = tostring(PolicyResult.PolicyName), Version = tostring(PolicyVersionResult.Version), PolicyMode = tostring(PolicyVersionResult.PolicyMode), BuildId = tostring(RuleResult.BuildId), PolicyRan = tobool(RuleResult.PolicyRan), PolicyPassed = tobool(RuleResult.PolicyPassed), Data = tostring(RuleResult.Data), MetaData = RuleResult.MetaData | union (RawMetrics | extend PolicyResults = RawGatingResult.PolicyResults | mv-expand PolicyResult = PolicyResults | where isnotnull(PolicyResult) | mv-expand RuleResult = PolicyResult.RuleResults | where isnotnull(RuleResult) | project CorrelationId, InsertedAt = now(), PolicyDomain = tostring(\u0027\u0027), PolicyName = tostring(PolicyResult.PolicyName), Version = tostring(\u0027default\u0027), PolicyMode = tostring(PolicyResult.PolicyMode), BuildId = tostring(RuleResult.BuildId), PolicyRan = tobool(RuleResult.PolicyRan), PolicyPassed = tobool(RuleResult.PolicyPassed), Data = tostring(RuleResult.Data), MetaData = RuleResult.MetaData)","IsTransactional":true,"PropagateIngestionProperties":true}]'

.alter table RuleExecutionMetrics policy update @'[{"IsEnabled":true,"Source":"RawMetrics","Query":"RawMetrics | extend DomainResults = RawGatingResult.DomainResults | mv-expand DomainResult = DomainResults | where isnotnull(DomainResult) | extend PolicyResults = DomainResult.PolicyResults | mv-expand PolicyResult = PolicyResults | where isnotnull(PolicyResult) | project CorrelationId, InsertedAt = now(), BuildId, PolicyDomain = tostring(DomainResult.PolicyDomain), PolicyName = tostring(PolicyResult.PolicyName), PolicyCompliantStatus = tostring(PolicyResult.PolicyCompliantStatus) | union (RawMetrics | extend PolicyResults = RawGatingResult.PolicyResults | mv-expand PolicyResult = PolicyResults | where isnotnull(PolicyResult) | project CorrelationId, InsertedAt = now(), BuildId, PolicyDomain = tostring(\u0027\u0027), PolicyName = tostring(PolicyResult.PolicyName), PolicyCompliantStatus = tostring(PolicyResult.PolicyCompliantStatus))","IsTransactional":true,"PropagateIngestionProperties":true}]'

command.value: @concat('.set-or-append PolicyVersionMetrics <| PolicyVersionMetrics_Backfill(datetime(', addHours(pipeline().parameters.BackfillStartDate, mul(item(), pipeline().parameters.ChunkSizeHours)), '), datetime(', addHours(pipeline().parameters.BackfillStartDate, mul(add(item(), 1), pipeline().parameters.ChunkSizeHours)), '))')

@concat('.set-or-append RuleExecutionMetrics <| RuleExecutionMetrics_Backfill(datetime(', addHours(pipeline().parameters.BackfillStartDate, mul(item(), pipeline().parameters.ChunkSizeHours)), '), datetime(', addHours(pipeline().parameters.BackfillStartDate, mul(add(item(), 1), pipeline().parameters.ChunkSizeHours)), '))')

activities.name: Validate_RowCounts
activities.description: Query row counts for PolicyVersionMetrics and RuleExecutionMetrics, plus check PolicyDomain population

source.query: let pvmCount = toscalar(PolicyVersionMetrics | count); let remCount = toscalar(RuleExecutionMetrics | count); let pvmEmptyDomain = toscalar(PolicyVersionMetrics | where isempty(PolicyDomain) | count); let remEmptyDomain = toscalar(RuleExecutionMetrics | where isempty(PolicyDomain) | count); print PolicyVersionMetricsCount=pvmCount, RuleExecutionMetricsCount=remCount, PVM_HasRows=pvmCount > 0, REM_HasRows=remCount > 0, PVM_EmptyPolicyDomain=pvmEmptyDomain, REM_EmptyPolicyDomain=remEmptyDomain

activities.name: CheckValidation_TablesHaveRows
activities.description: Fail if PolicyVersionMetrics or RuleExecutionMetrics has zero rows

message.value: @concat('VALIDATION FAILED: Backfilled tables have zero rows. PVM=', string(activity('Validate_RowCounts').output.firstRow.PolicyVersionMetricsCount), ' REM=', string(activity('Validate_RowCounts').output.firstRow.RuleExecutionMetricsCount))

activities.name: CheckValidation_PolicyDomainPopulated
activities.description: Fail if PolicyDomain is empty in PolicyVersionMetrics or RuleExecutionMetrics

message.value: @concat('VALIDATION FAILED: Empty PolicyDomain found. PolicyVersionMetrics has ', string(activity('Validate_RowCounts').output.firstRow.PVM_EmptyPolicyDomain), ' rows with empty PolicyDomain. RuleExecutionMetrics has ', string(activity('Validate_RowCounts').output.firstRow.REM_EmptyPolicyDomain), ' rows with empty PolicyDomain.')

activities.name: Validate_UpdatePoliciesEnabled
activities.description: Verify PolicyVersionMetrics and RuleExecutionMetrics update policies are re-enabled

source.query: .show table * policy update | where EntityName has 'PolicyVersionMetrics' or EntityName has 'RuleExecutionMetrics' | extend Policy=parse_json(tostring(parse_json(Policy)[0])) | extend IsEnabled=tobool(Policy.IsEnabled) | summarize DisabledCount=countif(IsEnabled == false), EnabledCount=countif(IsEnabled == true)

activities.name: CheckValidation_UpdatePoliciesEnabled
activities.description: Fail if any update policy is still disabled

message.value: @concat('VALIDATION FAILED: ', string(activity('Validate_UpdatePoliciesEnabled').output.firstRow.DisabledCount), ' update policies are still disabled. Expected both PVM and REM enabled.')
